Definition: from G2092; to prepare:--prepare, provide, make ready. Compare G2680.
BiblicalUsage: hetoimázō is the word for to prepare, to make ready. I meet it 40 times across the Bible, and Matthew is a good place to see it plainly. It says what it says, and I take it at face value.
TheologicalSignificance: What hetoimázō tells me is that God prepares His people for the work He has prepared for them. What I take from it is this — the plain sense is the safe sense.
RelatedEvents: The Baptism of Jesus; The Birth of John the Baptist
